user.title: Energy entities
user.description: Pick the lifetime energy counters for your system. Each must be a sensor with a state class of total or total_increasing - a power sensor in watts will not work, because the report reads long-term statistics. House load is worked out from these, so there is nothing to pick for it. Optionally add a solar power sensor in watts to show the day's power peak, and a battery level sensor in % to show the daily report's peak charge and when it was first reached. Add the battery's usable capacity too, and every report splits what went into the battery and did not come out into what is still stored and what was lost.

data.pv_power: Solar power (W, optional, for the peak)
data.battery_soc: Battery level (%, optional, for the daily peak charge)
data.battery_capacity: Battery capacity (kWh, optional, with the battery level: what was stored as against lost)

rates.title: Prices
rates.description:
**Price entities** hold your live rate, and are what every report is priced from. Pick the entity your tariff comes from, for example Predbat's predbat.rates and predbat.rates_export (in pence: choose hundredths), or an Octopus rate sensor such as Predbat's sensor.predbat_octopus_…_import_rates (in pounds: choose whole units). It does not have to be in the sensor domain.

Each one is recorded as Import rate (recorded) / Export rate (recorded), so every five minutes is priced at the rate in force at the time. Those sensors are copies of your price entity, not the fallback.

**Fallback prices** only matter for periods from before recording started - the first reports after installing. For those periods the price entity's own average is used if it has one (Predbat's does); otherwise this number; otherwise, at 0, the average of what was recorded. Never the price showing when the report runs, which in the evening is usually the peak.

**Standing charge** (optional): added to the Bill section only, never to the earnings, because it is paid with or without solar and a battery. Pick an entity holding the daily charge, such as Predbat's sensor.predbat_octopus_…_import_standing (in pounds: choose whole units), or type it. Its units are set separately from the prices.

**Octopoints** (optional): your Octoplus points balance, such as the Octopus Energy integration's octoplus_points sensor. Weekly and monthly reports show the balance, its value at 8 points to 1p, and how it changed.

**Planner savings** (optional): a running total of savings such as Predbat's, shown at the end of the report but not added to the total.

data.fallback_import_rate: Fallback import price (only before recording started)
data.fallback_export_rate: Fallback export price (only before recording started)
data.standing_charge: Standing charge per day (used when there is no entity; 0 leaves it out)
data.octopoints: Octopoints balance (optional, weekly and monthly reports)
data.arbitrage_sensor: Planner savings counter (optional, shown for reference)
data.arbitrage_gate: Only count savings when this entity...

delivery.title: Messaging
delivery.description: How the report is sent. Telegram gets the formatted version with bold headings; other methods get plain text. The next page asks for the chat or device.

delivery_details.title: Messaging details
delivery_details.description:
Telegram: pick the chat entities your Telegram bot created, or type chat IDs separated by commas (group chats start with a minus sign), or both.

Notify entity: pick one or more, for example your phone's.

Notify service: the service name, for example notify.mobile_app_my_phone.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Which reports to send and when. Weekly reports go out on Mondays and monthly ones on the 1st. The daily report can wait for sunset when that falls after the chosen time. These can also be changed from the device page.

error.not_a_total: That sensor has no long-term statistics. It needs a state class of total or total_increasing - pick the kWh counter, not the W power sensor.
error.not_a_measurement: That sensor has no max statistic. Pick a solar power sensor in watts with a state class of measurement.
error.bad_chat_id: Chat IDs must be whole numbers separated by commas, for example -1001234567890, 12345678.
error.no_chat: Pick at least one Telegram chat or type a chat ID.
error.no_telegram: The Telegram bot integration is not set up, so there is nothing to send through.
error.unknown_service: There is no such service. Check the name under Developer tools > Actions.
error.points_not_a_total: That sensor has no long-term statistics to read the change from. It needs a state class of total, as the Octopus Energy integration's Octoplus points sensor has.

energy.title: Energy entities
energy.description: The lifetime energy counters the report reads. Reports reach back through history, so a report covering a period from before a change reads the new counter for all of it. Change these when you replace a device or picked the wrong entity, not routinely. The battery level and capacity only change the battery lines and can be changed freely.

data.pv_power: Solar power (W, optional, for the peak)
data.battery_soc: Battery level (%, optional, for the daily peak charge)
data.battery_capacity: Battery capacity (kWh, optional, with the battery level: what was stored as against lost)
